name: elagoht/flash
description: A collage plugin for flash messages: a message an action sets before it redirects, shown once by the page it redirects to.

templateFunctions.name: flashes
templateFunctions.doc: The flash messages this request arrived with, each with `.Kind` and `.Text`; reading them clears them. `{{range flashes}}…{{end}}`.

collage-flash messages.description: collage-flash: show the messages this request arrived with

collage-flash toasts.description: collage-flash: the messages as toasts that remove themselves, with a script collage-secure's policy allows

config.description: A collage plugin for flash messages: a message an action sets before it redirects, shown once by the page it redirects to.

cookie.description: Cookie is the cookie's name. Default "collage_flash".

key.description: KeyHex is Key, hex-encoded, as configuration carries it.

maxAge.description: MaxAge is how many seconds an unshown message waits before it is dropped. Default 300.
